snippet.title: WITHERING REALMS - Release Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
WITHERING REALMS comes to Steam Early Access on September 2nd, wishlist today:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3441990/Withering_Realms

Explore the Occult Frontier with Clover and her doll as Withering Realms enters Early Access on September 2nd. Early Access includes the entire game, with over 50 weapons, 70 talismans, and 110 monsters to add to your bestiary. Explore the mysterious town of Penwyll and the sprawling graveyards, tombs, caves, and rotting estates that surround it in this new horror action RPG from the creator of Withering Rooms.
